name: Who handles drywall and finish work after a room addition in the Denver south-metro area?
description: A drywall and remodeling contractor can usually handle the hanging, taping, finishing, and texture work once the addition is framed and ready.

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowners in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker want one contractor to handle drywall and finishing after the addition framing is complete. That helps keep the project moving and reduces coordination problems between trades.
